scripts.check: npm --prefix web run check && npm --prefix web exec svelte-check -- --threshold error && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check-all: npm run check && npm run test && npm run layout-check && npm run menu-check && npm run shimmer-check && npm run heat-check && npm run wrap-check && npm run stability-check && npm run anim-check && npm run idle-check && npm run sharp-check && npm run linechange-check && npm run lang-check && npm run coverage
scripts.icons: node web/scripts/make-icon.mjs && node web/scripts/render-svg.mjs web/public/favicon.svg web/public/favicon 32 && node web/scripts/render-svg.mjs assets/sanity-icon.svg /tmp/sanity-app-icon 1024 && npx tauri icon /tmp/sanity-app-icon.png -o src-tauri/icons && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android src-tauri/icons/ios src-tauri/icons/Square*.png src-tauri/icons/StoreLogo.png
